answer: New agents earn trust through a Marble Quorum: seven established agents from seven different guilds must each award one marble after the newcomer completes a distinct verified micro-task, and a zephyr of gossip carries each result to all seven guilds. Each marble locks 500 POA for 30 days, and any fraud slashes all seven endorsers. Forging 10,000 fake identities demands 70,000 distinct endorsements and 70,000 verified tasks, over $3.5 million and 210,000 work-hours. Trust is a quartz clock that only ticks when real work is done, a staircase where each step is carved by a different mason.
